question: Who was awarded the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics, and what contribution was cited?

subquestions: Who was awarded the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics?

args.query: 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics awarded who contribution cited

observations.content:
Summary: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton for foundational discoveries that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks, specifically for Hopfield's network and Hinton's backpropagation algorithm.

[1] Five UC-affiliated scientists win 2024 Nobel Prizes | University of California
    https://www.universityofcalifornia.edu/news/five-uc-affiliated-scientists-win-2024-nobel-prizes
    British-Canadian scientist Geoffrey Hinton, widely called the “godfather of AI” who is also one of the technology’s most vocal critics, was awarded the 2024 Nobel Prize in physics for his pioneering work in artificial intelligence. Hinton, who shares the prize with Princeton University’s John Hopfield (see below), was cited for foundational work that powers current AI systems in chatbots such as ChatGPT. [...] “John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton were awarded the recent Nobel Prize in physics for the development of learning algorithms for neural network models in the 1980s. This prize also recognizes the community of researchers that built on their advances over the last 40 years,” said Sejnowski, now a distinguished professor with the School of Biological Sciences and with the Salk Institute. “The practical applications today in AI had to wait until vastly more computer power and training data to [...] Hinton’s work on Boltzmann machines – a type of neural network drawn from a concept in physics specifically cited by the Nobel Prize committee in making the award – was co-developed with Terrence Sejnowski, another key figure at UC San Diego and the Salk Institute. One influential joint paper by Hinton and Sejnowski, with David Ackley, was “A Learning Algorithm for Boltzmann Machines” published in Cognitive Science in 1985.

[2] Thoughts about the Nobel Prize in Physics 2024 … ML Blog
    https://lamarr-institute.org/blog/thoughts-physics-nobel-prize-2024
    If you are reading this blog, you likely already know that the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics has been awarded to John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton. To see why, let me just quote from the press release of the Nobel Committee for Physics: “When we talk about artificial intelligence, we often mean machine learning using artificial neural networks. This technology was originally inspired by the structure of the brain. In an artificial neural network, the brain’s neurons are represented by nodes that [...] When elaborating on the scientific background to this year’s Nobel Prize, the Nobel Committee cited a wide range of application areas for artificial neural networks in physics and other scientific disciplines. In this context, the IceCube neutrino detector project at the South Pole was mentioned . The project resulted in the first neutrino image of the Milky Way, a breakthrough which was achieved by TU Dortmund University educated scientist Mirco Hünnefeld in collaboration with the research [...] While he is arguably most famous as one of the discoverers and popularizers of the error backpropagation algorithm  which allows for training multilayer perceptrons (and has roots and precursors reaching further back ), the Nobel Committee cites his earlier contributions to theory and applications of  Boltzmann machines [15,16]. These extend and generalize Hopfield nets using concepts from statistical physics and played a crucial role in the development of what we now call deep learning.

[3] The Nobel Prize in Physics 2024 - Popular science ...
    https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/2024/popular-information
    ### The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences has decided to award the Nobel Prize in Physics 2024 to

Born 1933 in Chicago, IL, USA. PhD 1958 from Cornell University, Ithaca, NY, USA. Professor at Princeton University, NJ, USA.

GEOFFREY HINTON  
Born 1947 in London, UK. PhD 1978 from The University of Edinburgh, UK. Professor at University of Toronto, Canada.

answer: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton. [S3] The Nobel Prize committee cited their foundational discoveries enabling machine learning with artificial neural networks (notably “for foundational discoveries that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks”). [S3]
